claims.statement: For the explicit rank-three trigonometric projection P_n=R_n R_n^T, every original-coordinate bank whose conditional quadratic dependence can be represented exactly through one scalar linear aggregate has cardinality one.

No universal positive lower bound exists for the density-normalized 3x3 core of three disjoint scalar-sufficient banks: on P_n all such banks are singletons and every resulting normalized core has sigma_min<=3/n. This does not refute QFORM.
For an orthogonal projection P and an orthonormal compression U completed by W, with M=U^T P U and E=U^T P W, one has EE^T=M-M^2.
For n>=96 the explicit P_n family satisfies max_i(P_n)_ii=3/n<=1/32, so the completed ridge-window theorem gives a continuous C0 density with norm <=288 sqrt(3e)/13<64 for every allowed product law.

Jointly spend a density-normalized three-scalar compressed core and its forced within-bank leakage, without conditioning on dependent residual linear combinations inside the same original-coordinate banks.
